understanding.comment: You accurately captured the issue (wrong colour) and confirmed it back without asking for information already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: it arrives in 2 to 1 working days
resolution_accuracy.comment: Replacement delivery is 2 to 4 working days, not '2 to 1'; the timeline stated was incorrect and needs to be correct.

process_compliance.quote: Could you email us a photo of the pink set with the label, so a I can log at?
process_compliance.comment: You asked for a photo before arranging the replacement and promised a free return label by email, as the policy requires; however you did not ask permission before any hold, which did not occur, so this is compliant.

communication.comment: The caller was polite and the agent was courteous throughout, though the wording was often unclear and the caller was not upset so no acknowledgement was needed.

closing.comment: You confirmed the emails would arrive and asked if there was anything else, closing politely as expected.
